# Canonical Gateway API feature list advertised by Edgion.
#
# Single source of truth: edgion-resources `SUPPORTED_FEATURES`
# (edgion-resources/src/resources/gateway_class.rs).
# The controller writes these into GatewayClass.status.supportedFeatures, and
# the Go conformance suite (conformance_test.go) reads this file to derive its
# declared feature set, so the two cannot silently drift.
#
# Format: one feature name per line, sorted ascending. Blank lines and lines
# starting with '#' are ignored. Do not edit by hand — keep it byte-equal to
# SUPPORTED_FEATURES (guarded by the `shared_list_file_matches_supported_features`
# unit test in edgion-resources).
#
# Note: TCPRoute and UDPRoute are advertised by Edgion but are not part of any
# Gateway API conformance profile (absent from features.AllFeatures), so the Go
# suite keeps them in an explicit allowlist and does not declare them as
# conformance features.
BackendTLSPolicy
BackendTLSPolicySANValidation

Gateway

GatewayHTTPSListenerDetectMisdirectedRequests
HTTPRoute
HTTPRoute303RedirectStatusCode
